# Scale.jobs

> > AI-powered virtual assistant that automates job applications, optimizes resumes for ATS, and streamlines the entire job search process.

Scale.jobs is a job application automation platform founded by Leela Yanamaddi and Balaji Kummari that leverages AI to help job seekers apply to positions efficiently and increase their chances of landing interviews. The platform combines resume optimization, cover letter generation, and automated application submission with career development resources.

## Key Topics

- Job Application Automation
- ATS Optimization
- AI-Powered Resume Builder
- Cover Letter Generation
- Virtual Assistant
- Job Search Tools
- Interview Preparation
- Career Development
- Resume Writing
- Chrome Extension
- LinkedIn Integration
- Job Boards
- Career Platform
- H1B Visa Support
